div.div: خُزَعْبَلٌ i. q. بَاطِلٌ [app. as a subst., meaning A false, or vain, saying or deed or affair or thing]; as also ↓ خُزَعْبِيلٌ : (K:) or, accord. to El-Jarmee, (S, TA,) the latter, (S,) or each, (TA,) false, or vain, sayings or deeds or affairs or things. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
